description: This file defines the DeletePolicyEntry class in Java, which represents a command to delete a PolicyEntry in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, getting properties, and serialization logic. It is part of the policies command modification package.

classes.name: DeletePolicyEntry
classes.description: A command class for deleting a PolicyEntry identified by label from a specific policy, with JSON serialization/deserialization and related utility methods.
